components.name: Tftpd64 DHCP
components.purpose: Dedicated lab Ethernet DHCP service; other services disabled

redistribution.evidence: Official v4.74 archives include EUPL-EN.pdf; final redistribution/source-availability review remains pending.

detection.detail: Verify the service executable/version, effective INI source, DHCP-only service, scoped UDP/67 firewall, persistent lab address and pool exclusions. On multi-address Ethernet, validate DHCP LocalIP receive-interface filtering separately from the offered subnet and server identifier; require an actual OFFER and target-device lease before reporting network readiness.

installation.evidence: Official NSIS installer supports /S and returned 0 for local file installation. Development-host maintenance verified service registration, automatic start configuration, DHCP-only configuration and scoped firewall readback; clean target-machine installation and restart persistence remain pending. An additional Windows 11 host verified file installation, disabled service registration and Services=0/PoolSize=0 preparation with no UDP/67 listener; activation remains pending an explicitly selected connected lab interface/subnet.

components.recovery: Preserve compatible shared drivers and user data; restore only changes owned by this application.

validation.evidence: Development-host checks verified service/configuration/firewall readback and DISCOVER/OFFER. Multi-address Ethernet required a distinct DHCP receive-interface filter; after correction, a target instrument acquired a lease with a nonzero lease-start timestamp and was reachable at its matching MAC. This is lease evidence, not a saved full REQUEST/ACK packet trace. VISA broadcast discovery returned no resource. Computer-restart persistence and clean Windows 10/11 deployment acceptance remain pending. Raw evidence stays in runtime hardware-tests; reusable initialization requirements are maintained in docs/guides/lab-network-deployment.md.
